name: GlzToast
semanticRole: Deliver a transient confirmation or low-interruption status update with an optional single recovery action and no dependency on hover.

material.rule: Toasts use a compact raised or Thick Glaze surface with an opaque fallback. Critical warnings and decisions use persistent banners or dialogs instead.

input.keyboard: Toast actions are reachable when present; Escape may dismiss a focused dismissible toast without hijacking global shortcuts.
input.focus: Appearance never steals focus; when an action is focused its focus remains visible and predictable.
input.hover: Hover may pause timeout where supported but is never required to read or act.
input.press: The single optional action executes once; dismiss controls have explicit labels.

accessibility.role: Use status for routine confirmation and alert only for genuinely urgent non-modal errors; actions retain native button semantics.
accessibility.name: Keep the message concise and give action controls explicit accessible names.
accessibility.state: Success, error, and dismissibility are conveyed with text, icon, and state rather than color alone.
accessibility.value: Toast has no synthetic value; progress belongs in a progress component.
accessibility.keyboard: Appearance does not move focus and actionable toasts remain keyboard reachable while available.
accessibility.focus: Do not steal focus when announcing; action focus is visible and predictable.
accessibility.errorAssociation: Errors use explicit copy and may point to a persistent recovery surface when needed.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Use direct appearance or a short crossfade.
accessibility.reducedTransparency: Use an opaque raised or Solid Glaze surface.
accessibility.increasedContrast: Strengthen boundary, action, icon, and focus.
accessibility.forcedColors: Use system colors with no blur or color-only status.
accessibility.largeText: Wrap and grow vertically at 200% text without obscuring essential system controls.

fallbacks.reducedMotion: Use direct appearance or short crossfades.
fallbacks.reducedTransparency: Use opaque Raised or Solid Glaze.
fallbacks.highContrast: Strengthen boundary, focus, and semantic iconography.
fallbacks.forcedColors: Use system colors and remove blur and decorative shadow.
fallbacks.performance: Remove blur and shadow before changing announcement semantics, placement, or target geometry.

content.overflow: Wrap concise messages and allow one optional action; longer instructions or multiple actions move to a banner, popover, or dialog.
content.localization: Confirmation text and action labels tolerate 30–50% expansion without truncating consequences.
content.rtl: Logical placement and action ordering mirror while announcement order remains message then action.

criteria: Toast is noticeable without interrupting the task.
Confirmation, error, and optional recovery action remain understandable without color alone.
Toast never masquerades as a modal or carries multiple competing actions.
